summary: An enum field with dependencies and allOf can show different fields per option: choosing PostgreSQL shows a version enum 13/14/15 (default 15), choosing MySQL replaces it with 5.7/8.0 (default 8.0). Each if/then block matches one enum value.
questions: How do I show different fields depending on a dropdown choice?
How do I build a database-type dependent version field in a Backstage template?
How many if/then blocks do I need for an enum dependency?
